errors.text_span: Die rechte Grafik ist eine Linienkarte
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the right-hand chart as a line chart ('Linienkarte'). In fact, it is a stacked bar chart with a superimposed line.

errors.text_span: während in der rechten Grafik nur eine Linie dargestellt ist
errors.evidence: This claim is incorrect. The right-hand chart clearly displays colored stacked bars for the categories 'Bund', 'Länder', and 'Gemeinden' in addition to the black line.

The description completely omits any mention or description of the stacked bars in the right-hand chart (their colors, categories, and the fact that some have negative values). This is a core component of the visualization.
The description of the left chart fails to mention the black line representing 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt' (total public authorities), which is clearly visible and included in the legend.
